subject: Visibility pricing: pay-as-you-go vs committed slabs
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@fortifyai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-18T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on visibility add-on pricing

Hi Connor / Kimberly,

Thanks for the brief last week — as we dig into the procurement side I need a clear comparison for our finance team between two packaging approaches for observability (retention + tracing + advanced dashboards). High level: we're trying to decide between a pure pay-as-you-go model vs a committed slab that buys bulk retention and tracing capacity.

Some context on FortifyAI usage (approx):
- Trace ingestion: ~200k spans/day
- Retention currently: 30 days (we are evaluating 90-day and 180-day options)
- Dashboards: ~20 dashboards, ~8 heavy users (daily)
- Current spend target for tooling: $100k/yr (looking to consolidate)

Questions for you:
1) Can you provide an apples-to-apples cost model for PAYG vs 1yr committed slab (with included credits)?
2) Any pilot/intro credits for year 1?
3) What are breakpoints for slab sizes (e.g., 10TB-mo, 50TB-mo) and the delta to PAYG?
4) How do advanced dashboards get priced (seat vs query vs visualization)?

If you can send a short PDF and an example cost sheet we can share with procurement. Also happy to schedule 30m on Tue/Thu.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Park
VP, Platform Engineering
FortifyAI

--
Note: attachment: Fortify_current_metrics.csv (referenced)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@fortifyai.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on visibility add-on pricing

Elena — really helpful context, thanks. I'll put forward a concise comparison and attach a cost worksheet. High level answers up front, then I'll follow with the worksheet and a couple of scenarios:

- PAYG: good for smaller/variable ingestion; single-meter billing (GB-month for retention + per-M throughput for trace ingest). Typical effective rate we see for customers at your scale: ~$0.035/GB-month for trace storage and $0.012/GB for cold archive. Dashboards priced per active user + query credits; rough ballpark $125/user/mo for heavy dashboard users.

- Committed slab (1yr) - offers 20–35% discount vs PAYG depending on commitment size and term. Slabs are sized by included TB-months and an included query allowance. Breakpoints: 10TB-mo, 50TB-mo, 200TB-mo. Bigger slabs add layered discounts and one-time setup credits.

- Pilot: we typically offer a $15k pilot credit or a 60-day no-cost evaluation for the visibility pack for new customers moving observability to Redwood.

Next steps: I'm attaching the worksheet (Fortify_pricing_options_v1.pdf) and an example usage CSV. If you can confirm target retention (90 or 180) and expected monthly GB ingest we'll populate the numbers.

Available Tue 10–12 or Thu 14–16 PT for a 30m call.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Fortify_pricing_options_v1.pdf, Fortify_usage_breakdown.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@fortifyai.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility pricing: pay-as-you-go vs committed slabs

Elena / Connor — I've put together three concrete scenarios and a compact price grid (attached). Summary here:

Scenario A — PAYG (monthly):
- Trace storage: $0.035/GB-month (hot), $0.012/GB-month (cold)
- Dashboards: $125/heavy-user/month; $35/light-user/month
- No upfront; elastic scaling; no committed discount

Scenario B — 1yr slab (50 TB-month included):
- Effective storage: ~$0.028/GB-month (net) (includes 20% discount)
- 5k query credits included; additional queries $0.008/credit
- 10% off dashboard seats for >=12 seats
- One-time onboarding credit: $8k

Scenario C — 1yr slab (200 TB-month included):
- Effective storage: ~$0.022/GB-month (net) (includes 30% discount)
- 25k query credits included; additional queries $0.006/credit
- Advanced dashboards: bundled (no per-seat charge) up to 25 power-users; additional seats $75/user/mo
- One-time onboarding credit: $25k

Concessions we can move on if needed: up to +5% extra discount for first year (manager approval), or a one-time $20k credit in lieu of a higher annual commitment.

I've attached the RDW_observability_pack_grid.csv with the numeric comparison so procurement can run their scenario. Connor — can you confirm if we'll offer the $15k pilot credit or the $20k credit concession if Fortify chooses the 50 TB slab?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_observability_pack_grid.csv

From: Elena Park <elena.park@fortifyai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Visibility pricing: pay-as-you-go vs committed slabs

Thanks — the scenarios are extremely helpful. A couple follow-ups after reviewing the grid:

- Our finance team will only accept a committed slab if there's either an onboarding credit or first-year discount that materially offsets migration costs. The $8k onboarding for 50TB looks light; 25k for 200TB is closer to acceptable.
- For our usage shape (200k spans/day, estimated ingest ~2TB/mo hot), the 50TB slab looks borderline and 200TB is probably more than we need year 1. Can you provide a mid-point (100TB) pricing?
- Dashboard licensing: can you confirm whether dedicated dashboards (read-only embeds for product teams) require a seat per end-reader or only per editor?

Also — procurement requested a standard contract term for commitments and what the overage pricing would be (monthly true-up at PAYG rates or pro-rated slab add-on).

If we can get a 100TB slab number and clarify dashboard seat rules I can take this to procurement. Can you also confirm whether the $20k one-time credit would be available in lieu of pilot credit if we commit to 1yr 50TB?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Elena

--
Quoted earlier: "If you can send a short PDF and an example cost sheet we can share with procurement. Also happy to schedule 30m on Tue/Thu."

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-20T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Visibility pricing: pay-as-you-go vs committed slabs (approval needed)

Team — forwarding Fortify's procurement ask. Key points: they want a 100TB figure and stronger onboarding credit (they consider $8k insufficient). They're also asking whether $20k one-time credit can replace pilot credit for a 50TB 1yr commitment.

Proposed concession for approval:
- Offer a 100TB 1yr slab at an effective $0.025/GB-month (net) with 10k query credits and bundled dashboards for up to 15 editors.
- Replace pilot credit with a $20k one-time onboarding credit if they sign the 50TB slab in the next 14 days.
- If they push for deeper discount, allow Marissa to sign off up to 15% total first-year effective discount; anything beyond routes to Revenue Ops.

Rationale: Fortify is consolidation opportunity, likely multi-year. The 100TB gives them headroom and keeps our unit economics sane. I'm asking Marissa and Grace for quick sign-off so we can respond to procurement today.

Connor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

--
On approval: Kimberly suggested the $20k as alternate concession. Please reply-all with APPROVE/DECLINE and any counter-suggested limit.
